title: Highly recommend
text: Terrific tour. Terrific guide/driver. Vladimir was a great guide for this hike. Very nice, informative, and patient guide. We had a great time and the views along and at the top of the hike were tremendous. We loved it.
author: Christine_R

title: Very good trip, Ferran...
text: Very good trip, Ferran was a very knowledgeable and experienced guide. Being on a less crowded path was nice too, and Ferran is flexible on pace and location of the hike. Would recommend to friends.
author: Elgin_L

title: The views were absolutely...
text: The views were absolutely beautiful! An unforgettable hike using snow shoes for the first time. It was worth it.
author: Ashley_B

title: Great hiking and mushroom hunting with Ferran
text: I had an amazing time hiking in the Pyrenees with Ferran! He provided great explanations of local Catalan culture and the unique biology of the forests in the Pyrenees, and speaks impeccable English in addition to Spanish and Catalan. We hiked ~8-9 miles and around 1800 feet of elevation gain in about 5 hours, with several breaks for mushroom-hunting (we found many chanterelles). Would definitely recommend for hikers of all abilities.
author: xxMonicaS_2022

title: Pyrenees day hike
text: It’s an amazing part of the world. Vladimir is a nice guy and I recommend him. It’s great to get out into nature and give you a different perspective to the region you’re visiting.
author: Adrian_L

title: Experience was great!

author: Jon_V

title: The most incredible hike in the Pyrenees!
text: This was such an incredible day! The hike was challenging but the views were more rewarding than I ever could have imagined. We climbed 3 mountain summits and saw the most incredible 360 degree views of the Pyrenees mountains. Pere was an excellent tour guide and provided us with all the necessary equipment we needed, including snow shoes which he taught us how to use! The tour was private and small (my boyfriend and I plus a mother and her son), which made the hike even more special. title: Phenomenal experience!
text:
We had an excellent time on our hike with Pere to Gallina Pelada. He was knowledgeable, friendly and took the time to answer any questions we had. Pere made sure we had the right equipment (and nourishment) before heading out and his enthusiasm made him fun to hike with. Our hike wasn’t easy (snow, rocks, and 1000’ of elevation change) but was worth the effort for the amazing summit and views of the Pyrenees.

Pere’s door to door service was a huge bonus and we would not hesitate to recommend him for other hikers.
author: hpj7mzkvpd

title: great hike
text: this was a wonderful hike pretty challenging. Our guide picked us up promptly at our hotel in Barcelona. Then we drove about an hour and a half to a small little café to review our trail choices. We were able to get a cup of coffee and a sandwich for the hike. The hike we chose was a little more challenging for me so I had to stop and rest while my friend actually did the summit ha ha.
author: Pamela_A

title: Climb to Gallina Pelada
text: Pere was so kind and patient and shared his love and knowledge on the drive and hike. One other guest much younger and stronger than me but it was perfect. He made sure we stayed hydrated and fed and warm. It snowed for a few minutes on our resent!  Had never been above the tree line and it was spectacular. Pere gently held my hand and led me down the difficult areas then released my hand when it was safe. Stayed at the hut while they summitted Gallina Pelada as the weather was ominous.
